tech.summary: OpenAI will start embedding an invisible statistical watermark (called textGrain) into ChatGPT and Codex text for EU users over the coming weeks, to comply with the EU AI Act's machine-readable labelling rule. API customers worldwide can opt in; the detector stays limited to approved researchers because watermarking is still unreliable against paraphrasing and short texts.
tech.title: OpenAI to add invisible watermarks to ChatGPT text in EU

tech.summary: Anthropic is expanding its Cyber Verification Program, letting vetted cybersecurity professionals test Claude Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Mythos 5.1 with reduced safeguards. Its earlier Project Glasswing helped partners find 129,000+ verified software vulnerabilities between April and July, over 33,000 rated critical or high severity.
tech.title: Anthropic expands Cyber Verification Program for security teams

tech.summary: Anthropic launched Claude for Google Workspace in public beta on all paid Claude plans — a sidebar add-on that reads the open Doc, Sheet or Slide, makes in-place edits, writes formulas and pivot tables, and builds new slides. New connectors also let Claude create Google files directly from chat.
tech.title: Claude arrives inside Google Docs, Sheets and Slides as public beta

tech.summary: Microsoft hosts its first major Windows showcase in over two years today in San Francisco (10 AM PT), themed around local/on-device AI. CEO Satya Nadella and Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang are both attending, fuelling expectations of pricing and launch details for the NVIDIA RTX Spark-powered Surface Laptop Ultra.
tech.title: Microsoft's big Windows + Surface event lands today with Nadella and Jensen Huang

tech.summary: SpaceX is seeking to raise about $40 billion — $10B in bank loans plus $30B in investment-grade debt, led by Apollo Global Management — to fund a massive Nvidia AI chip order, the FT reported. The deal, expected to close in 2027, underlines how the AI boom is now a capital-raising race for compute.
tech.title: SpaceX seeks $40 billion to buy Nvidia chips, FT reports

tech.summary: The 10th India Mobile Congress begins today in New Delhi (Oct 7-10) with the theme 'Scale Without Boundaries'. The agenda covers 6G, AI-native telecom networks, semiconductors, satellite communications, quantum, cybersecurity and robotics, drawing 20+ global telecom operators.
tech.title: India Mobile Congress 2026 kicks off today with 6G and AI in focus

pakistan.summary: Pakistan conducted a successful test launch of the indigenously developed extended version of the Fatah-4 ground-launched cruise missile on Oct 6, ISPR said. Fitted with advanced avionics and navigation aids, it can hit targets at extended ranges with high precision. The President, PM and services chiefs congratulated the scientists and engineers.
pakistan.title: Pakistan successfully tests extended-range Fatah-4 cruise missile

pakistan.summary: Pakistan and the IMF are finalising the Memorandum of Economic and Fiscal Policies as review talks enter their last stage, with a staff-level agreement expected this week. That would unlock about $1.2 billion under the EFF and RSF. FBR beat its Q1 collection target (Rs3,043bn), reducing the chance of a mini-budget.
pakistan.title: Pakistan, IMF near staff-level deal; $1.2bn disbursement in sight

pakistan.summary: Deputy PM Ishaq Dar told an International Water Symposium in Vienna that any attempt to deprive Pakistan of its Indus waters would have 'serious implications' for regional peace and security. He cited the Permanent Court of Arbitration's Aug 31 award confirming the Indus Waters Treaty remains fully in force despite India's 'abeyance'.
pakistan.title: Dar warns depriving Pakistan of Indus waters risks regional peace

pakistan.summary: OGRA revised fuel prices for Oct 7 under the daily pricing mechanism: petrol rises Rs1.19 to Rs394.83/litre, while high-speed diesel falls Rs1.91 to Rs395.85/litre. Prices track a 7-day average of international Platts rates; Friday-notified rates hold over the weekend.
pakistan.title: Petrol up Rs1.19, diesel down Rs1.91 for Oct 7 under daily pricing

pakistan.summary: The KSE-100 Index rebounded 2,592.79 points (1.56%) to close at 168,460.10 on Tuesday, recovering from Monday's 2,288-point plunge. Easing international oil prices and hopes of lower political noise drove buying across banks, energy, cement and autos.
pakistan.title: PSX claws back 2,593 points as easing oil lifts sentiment

pakistan.summary: Punjab CM Maryam Nawaz received the UN-Habitat Scroll of Honour 2026 in Muscat on World Habitat Day for the 'Apni Chhat, Apna Ghar' housing programme — one of only five initiatives selected worldwide. The scheme has disbursed interest-free housing loans to over 200,000 applicants so far.
pakistan.title: Maryam Nawaz receives UN-Habitat Scroll of Honour in Muscat
